correctness.rationale: For any prime p, b_n=p^{νp(F_{n+1})} violates a necessary Dold prime-power congruence after every finite positive multiplier K: find one prime q and unbounded s with b_{q^s}−b_{q^{s−1}}=c !=0 fixed. For odd p!=5, rank r|p−(5/p), gcd(r,p)=1; Dirichlet+CRT choose q≡−1(mod r), q≡1(mod p), and classical Fibonacci valuations make the even-s difference 1−p^e. For p=2, q=5 and even s give 1−8=−7 from rank 3 and ν2(F_m)=ν2(m)+2 when 6|m. For p=5, q=19, s=10j+2 give 1−5=−4 by LTE. If K b is Dold, q^s divides fixed nonzero Kc for infinitely many s, contradiction. Independently used modular Fibonacci fast-doubling to verify 63 relevant prime-power differences across the first 16 primes through 53; infinite proof requires classical valuation, rank, Dirichlet, CRT and LTE.
